scenes.title: Scene 1: Experience & Skills Hook
scenes.voiceover: You have the experience, you have the skills, now it's time to take your career to the next level,

scenes.title: Scene 2: NHIT Durgapur Campus Intro
scenes.voiceover: introducing NHIT Durgapur, your opportunity to advance through technical education,

scenes.title: Scene 3: Diploma Engineering Programmes
scenes.voiceover: choose your next step, diploma in electrical engineering or mechanical engineering, especially offered under the working professional category.

scenes.title: Scene 4: Candidate Eligibility Matrix
scenes.voiceover: Are you eligible? If you have the required academic qualification, 10 plus 2 with applicable subjects, 10 plus 2 vocational, or class 10 with a 2 year ITI qualification in an appropriate trade, along with a minimum of one year of full-time work experience, this opportunity could be for you.

scenes.title: Scene 5: Statutory Affiliation & AICTE
scenes.voiceover: We are affiliated to the West Bengal State Council of Technical and Vocational Education and Skill Development and approved by AICTE for the academic session 2026-27, don't stop at experience, add a qualification to your skills.

scenes.title: Scene 6: Limited Seats Capacity Urgency
scenes.voiceover: Hurry up, we have limited seats capacity. NHIT brings you an opportunity to strengthen your technical qualifications.

scenes.title: Scene 7: Final Branding & Helpline Callout
scenes.voiceover: NHIT Durgapur, shaping engineers, building futures, visit www.nhit.in or contact NHIT at +91 98005 71423 for admission details. Your experience, your next qualification, your future.
